item.title: Military Ties Agreement: US and Venezuela restore cooperation; political future remains uncertain
item.description: In a significant development, the United States has established a new military partnership with Venezuela following the capture of Nicolás Maduro. The agreement, announced by US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, involves collaborative military training and intelligence sharing. Although Maduro has been ousted, Delcy Rodríguez remains in charge amid prevailing political instability. Additionally, the re-emergence of opposition leader María Corina Machado hints at the possibility of free elections in the nation. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Psychology says a few minutes of your speech may reveal how fast your brain is aging
item.description: A groundbreaking speech clock has been developed by researchers to evaluate speech patterns and estimate biological age. This innovative tool highlights the potential relationship between speech traits and cognitive decline, including dementia. Involving nearly 3,000 Spanish-speaking participants from various Latin American nations, the results suggest that noticeable differences in speech age may signal cognitive difficulties. Future research is essential to further explore the role of speech analysis in cognitive evaluations. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Climate change can worsen income inequality
item.description: A study published in Sustainable Development that analyzed the relationship between climate change and income inequality for 23 emerging market economies from 2002 to 2022 found that greater climate pressure is positively associated with income inequality across three different inequality indicators (the Gini coefficient, the Palma ratio and the Theil index).
